articles.title: UK raises concern over India's 162.5% bulk Scotch duty as trade pact dispute continues
articles.description: The UK is concerned about India's high import duties on bulk Scotch whisky despite a recent trade agreement. Current duties on bulk Scotch stand at 162.5 percent, even after a negotiated reduction to 75 percent. Disputes over customs classifications have led to significant delays in Scotch imports, affecting several liquor companies. The British government is actively working with India to resolve these issues promptly.
